copy.headline: How you protect a relationship changes how pressure accumulates and clears inside it.
copy.body: Agreeableness shapes accommodation, trust, and conflict style; emotionality shapes the internal reaction and recovery after friction. Together they influence whether you address, absorb, or delay a concern.
copy.strength_sentence: Reading both traits distinguishes genuine ease, strategic restraint, and restraint that carries a hidden cost.
copy.risk_sentence: Surface cooperation can hide internal load, while emotional reaction alone can hide a deliberate boundary choice.
copy.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest in sustained collaboration, close relationships, and boundary negotiation; brief low-stakes contact may not reveal it.
copy.action_hook: Review what you expressed, what you withheld, and how long recovery took.
